# Cyca：寄給隱私向評測與榜單的 pitch 信（cyca-05）

| 項目 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 用途 | 讓重視隱私的評測與比較文章知道有一款「不用帳號、沒有伺服器、資料只在手機」的經期 App，請他們在下次更新時自行評估是否收錄。只提供資訊，不要求刊登、不要求名次 |
| 發在哪／給誰 | 信 1：Bearable（bearable.app）部落格的經期 App 比較文（英文）。信 2：Mozilla Foundation 的 *Privacy Not Included 指南（英文）。信 3：mybest 台灣（tw.my-best.com）的生理期 App 排行（繁體中文） |
| 發送者 | 擁有者 Guan Feng Lai 本人，用自己的信箱寄，署名 Lumi Studio；每封第一段都寫明是開發者本人 |
| 發送規則 | 只用對方網站上公開的官方聯絡表單或信箱（Contact／About／投稿、商品資訊提供頁）；找不到官方管道就不寄，不猜信箱、不私訊作者個人帳號。每個對象只寄一次、不追信，兩週沒回就當作不適合。附 3–4 張真實截圖（免費功能與 Pro 功能分開標示）。不提價格數字、評分數、排名；不說「best／#1／最準」；不提其他經期 App 的名字或批評它們。不提供任何「收錄就送…」的條件；若對方回覆付費刊登或廣告方案，婉拒，不改成付費合作 |
| 寄出前必做 | 1）打開 App Store 的 Cyca 頁面，確認隱私權標示仍是「Data Not Collected／未收集資料」；不是就刪掉那一行。2）信 2：先確認 *Privacy Not Included 目前仍在更新、仍接受產品建議，且有官方建議管道；已停止更新就不寄。3）信 1：確認該比較文仍在、2026 年有更新。4）「可提供 Pro 兌換代碼」那句只有在你確實能在 App Store Connect 產生代碼時才保留。5）若 cyca-03 已把「下次經期預測」改為免費，改寫三封信的「收費方式」段落。6）確認「每日身體預報」是免費還是 Pro 功能（商店文案沒寫），截圖上的免費／Pro 標示要與實際一致 |
| 事實依據 | `_engine/data/cyca_full.json` 的 en-US 與 zh-Hant 商店文案：無帳號、無伺服器、資料不離開裝置、完全離線、無廣告、無追蹤；功能＝記錄經血量／症狀／心情／筆記、日曆顯示經期／易孕期／排卵、每日身體預報、預測會隨記錄調整、個人節律、智慧規劃、經期與 PMS 前提醒、每日照護計畫；免費＝記錄今天與經期，Cyca Pro（一次買斷）＝未來預測、個人節律、智慧規劃、完整日曆紀錄、更深入個人化；非醫療器材、非避孕方法。隱私標示「未收集資料」（來自 cyca-05 行動說明，寄前再確認）。50 種介面語言、App 內切換（擁有者確認） |
| 不能寫 | 體溫、性行為紀錄、匯出、iCloud 同步、Apple Watch、密碼鎖等商店文案沒有的功能；任何避孕或「安全期」用途；「醫學驗證」「準確率」；價格 |
| 連結 | 信 1：https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_bearable&mt=8 ；信 2：https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_pni&mt=8 ；信 3：https://apps.apple.com/tw/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_mybest&mt=8 |

## 信 1：Bearable（英文）

**Subject:** For your period tracker comparison: Cyca, a cycle tracker with no account and no servers

```text
Hi Bearable team,

I'm Guan Feng Lai, the developer of Cyca: Period & Cycle Tracker, an iPhone app from my small studio, Lumi Studio, in Taiwan. I saw that you compare period tracking apps, and I'd like to suggest Cyca for readers who put privacy first, in case it's useful when you next update the article.

The privacy side, all of which you can check yourself:
- No account. There is no sign-up screen; you start logging the first time you open the app.
- No servers. Cyca has no backend, so cycle data stays on the iPhone and never leaves the device.
- Works fully offline. You can turn on Airplane Mode and keep using it.
- The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected". No ads, no tracking.

What it does:
- Log flow, symptoms, moods and notes in a few taps
- A calm calendar showing period days, fertile window and ovulation
- A Daily Body Forecast: a gentle daily reading of energy, mood, skin and comfort based on cycle phase
- Predictions that adapt every time you log, Personal Rhythm (how your body tends to move through each phase), and a Smart Planner that highlights your best and gentlest days
- A kind heads-up before your period or PMS
- 50 interface languages, switchable inside the app

How it's paid for, so readers aren't surprised: tracking today and your period is free. Future predictions, Personal Rhythm, the Smart Planner and full calendar history are in Cyca Pro, a one-time in-app purchase. There is no subscription.

One important caveat: Cyca gives wellness and planning estimates. It is not a medical device and not a form of contraception, and the App Store description says so.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_bearable&mt=8

I've attached a few screenshots, each labeled free or Pro. If it helps your testing, I can provide a code that unlocks Pro.

There's no payment involved and no need to reply. If it doesn't fit, no worries at all.

Best,
Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio
```

## 信 2：Mozilla *Privacy Not Included（英文）

**Subject:** Product suggestion: Cyca, an iPhone period tracker with no account and no servers

```text
Hello *Privacy Not Included team,

I'm Guan Feng Lai, the developer of Cyca: Period & Cycle Tracker for iPhone (Lumi Studio, Taiwan). I'm writing as the developer, so please weigh this accordingly. I'd like to suggest Cyca as a product to look at if you review period and cycle tracking apps again.

What I can state, and what you can verify independently:
- There is no account and no sign-up. The app works from first launch without an email or login.
- There are no servers. Cyca has no backend; cycle data is stored on the device and never leaves it.
- The app works fully offline, including with Airplane Mode on.
- The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected". There are no ads and no tracking.

What it does: logging of flow, symptoms, moods and notes; a calendar of period days, fertile window and ovulation; a Daily Body Forecast; and predictions that adapt as you log. It is a wellness and planning tool: it is not a medical device and not a form of contraception, and the App Store description states this.

Business model: tracking today and your period is free; predictions and some other features are in Cyca Pro, a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription. There is no advertising or data-based revenue.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_pni&mt=8

I'm happy to answer any question about how the app handles data. If testing would need Pro, I can provide an unlock code. No reply is needed if it isn't a fit.

Thank you for the work you do,
Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio
```

> 「There is no advertising or data-based revenue」：商店文案寫無廣告、無追蹤、資料不離開裝置，收入只有 Pro 買斷；若有任何其他收入來源，刪掉這句。

## 信 3：mybest 台灣（繁體中文）

**主旨：** 生理期 App 評比參考：Cyca（不需帳號、資料只存在手機）

```text
mybest 編輯部 您好：

我是 iPhone 經期紀錄 App「Cyca 經期週期追蹤・排卵」的開發者 Guan Feng Lai（Lumi Studio，台灣）。看到 mybest 有生理期 App 的比較文章，想提供 Cyca 的資訊給編輯部參考，作為日後更新時是否評估的參考。

可以實際驗證的隱私特點：
・不需註冊帳號：第一次打開就能直接記錄，沒有註冊畫面
・沒有伺服器：週期資料只存在手機裡，不會離開裝置
・可完全離線使用：開飛航模式也能照常使用
・App Store 隱私權標示為「未收集資料」，沒有廣告、沒有追蹤

主要功能：
・幾秒記錄經血量、症狀、心情與筆記
・療癒系日曆，以柔和顏色標示經期、易孕期與排卵日
・「每日身體預報」：依週期階段解讀當天的能量、心情、膚況與舒適度
・會隨每次記錄調整的預測、「個人節律」與「智慧規劃」
・經期或經前症候群來臨前的貼心提醒
・介面有 50 種語言，可在 App 內直接切換

收費方式：免費版可以記錄當天狀態與生理期；下次經期預測、個人節律、智慧規劃與完整日曆紀錄，需要一次買斷 Cyca Pro，不是訂閱。

也想特別說明：Cyca 提供的是健康與規劃的估算，不是醫療器材，也不可作為避孕方法，App Store 描述中也有標示。

App Store：https://apps.apple.com/tw/app/id6782251621?pt=118326163&ct=cyca_press_mybest&mt=8

附上幾張實際畫面截圖（已標示免費／Pro）。若評測時需要使用 Pro 功能，我可以提供兌換代碼。

這封信不涉及任何付費刊登或交換條件；若不符合編輯部的需求，不需回覆。謝謝您撥冗閱讀。

Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio
```
